acceptanceCriteria: A proposed spec (human acceptance required) defines the input/output contract, grouping and isolation rules, determinism and fail-closed check, with non-goals, failure modes and rollback.
After acceptance: implementation with focused and hostile tests, a real-repository qualification and sealed change evidence; GitHub #681 closed by the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#681. Add a corvint test-plan consolidate projection (or MCP consolidate_tests) taking variations (ids + route/screen/setup anchors) and existing tests from test-validity, returning: groups sharing fixture state + screen + user that can be ordered steps of one test; variations needing isolation with the reason; existing passing tests that already witness a variation; duplicate variations. Output a compact table (test | spec | variation ids | isolated reason) that can be checked fail-closed. Builds on the application map (#657) and scenario planner (#660).
title: Test consolidation planner: group variations into the minimum set of focused tests (GitHub #681)
